svg.title: JMR clean architecture: software Toolbox and bounded hardware services
svg.desc: Run81 implementation and RTL-simulation candidate. Finder and applications share native JavaScript Toolbox code, normalized typed resources and bounded hardware primitives. One candidate, no new FPGA build authorized; physical acceptance is separate.
svg.text: Macintosh-inspired organization • one native JavaScript CPU • software owns common UI policy
ONE CANDIDATE · Run81 RTL simulation · matched software + disk · no FPGA build authorized
Application behavior → shared software → bounded system services → FPGA mechanisms
HTML / JavaScript → JSH · same processor as Finder
DESKTOP.FDR on a flat FAT root
File / Edit / View / Special use the shared software menu system.
One active application; shared instructions, private application state.
02 TOOLBOX SOFTWARE · RESIDENT + SHARED CLIENT MODULES
ROM shares common instructions; inline client modules hold window stacks and app-specific document / control policy.
Cooperative events + frames. Pausing an app does not remove the independent keyboard / emergency recovery path.
Versioned native services; no browser or extra CPU
Hardware transfers bytes and performs explicit operations; software chooses the policy.
Validate ROM / SYS / JSH; LOAD / RUN
Escape exit; About key 254 → software UI
Typed TBF1 data, read through Toolbox
Objects / globals / mutable data stay private
The .bit defines the circuits. Replaced classic menu / dialog / document / system-action controllers are removed.
USB keyboard J15; PS/2 JA + JC
One VM and one drawing canvas
WHAT CAN CHANGE WITHOUT A NEW .bit?
Software algorithms / menus / dialogs: update ROM + LNK + matching apps, then cold machine restart.
New hardware access / formats / instruction capacity / clocks: edit RTL → Vivado → qualify a new .bit.
Bank: 8096 / 8191 mutable instructions used; 95 spare. Fixed final jump and app-owned state are unchanged.
Typed access + scissor require matching new circuits; later UI policy updates use software. Old INIT audits stay historical.
44 programs / 42 resident clients. Candidate disk: build/run81_mac_native/card.img. Final RTL acceptance tracked in manifest; no FPGA/physical qualification.
Sources: Toolbox / Finder JavaScript, RTL, RESIDENT_TOOLBOX.md, TOOLBOX_API.md. Release evidence: TOOLBOX_IMPLEMENTATION_STATUS.md.
